title: 2.14 Review: new people, new places
unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
goal: Review every A1+ Unit 2 step with new people: where they go and how, what they have, short forms, but, ordinals, favorite, -es and irregular plurals, ones, -er than, Don't and light/dark, with no new language.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.14 Unit 2 Review: A1 reviews Unit 2 with fresh scenes; A1+ 2.14 reviews every A1+ Unit 2 step with eight fresh photos of new people and no new language: goes to (2.1), How does … go …? and by bike (2.2), has and Does … have …? (2.3), What's, It's and isn't (2.4), but (2.5), the third floor and lives on (2.6-2.7), favorite (2.8), women and watches (2.9), ones (2.10), taller than (2.11), Don't (2.12) and light or dark blue (2.13). Nobody in the photos speaks in the first person (the cast's voices belong to the cast), so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers.
speaking_outcome: Say what new people do and have, where they live and go, and compare and describe them, with every Unit 2 form, at a natural pace.
